title: Constraint-aware schedule QA copilot for dental practices
problem: Dental practices often book appointments without reliably enforcing practice-specific constraints such as shared equipment, provider and assistant availability, procedure duration, chair capacity, production targets, and sequencing rules.
target_user: Independent and small-group dental practices with 2+ providers/chairs using an existing PMS
solution_wedge: Practice-specific scheduling guardrails and QA inside the existing PMS workflow.
red_team_update: Fresh review found closer overlap than previously recorded. Dentina advertises direct PMS booking using practice rules and correct providers/operatories; NexV offers AI schedule optimization; DSM ScheduleGenius integrates with Dentrix/Eaglesoft/Open Dental. The exact constraint-QA wedge may still differ, but differentiation is no longer strong enough to cross the notification threshold without paid customer evidence.
next_step: Only continue via customer discovery: obtain real scheduling rule sets from 3 practices and ask whether current PMS/AI tools fail those constraints; seek paid audit before building.

title: Prior Authorization Evidence-Pack Copilot for small US medical practices
problem: Small medical practices lose substantial staff time navigating payer-specific prior-authorization criteria, finding chart evidence, matching insurer wording, tracking denials and preparing appeals.
target_user: Small US specialty and primary-care practices handling meaningful prior-authorization volume without large dedicated RCM teams
solution_wedge: Evidence assembly and payer-criteria mapping on top of the existing EHR.
red_team_update: The pain and 2027 API tailwind are stronger than before, but the proposed wedge is now directly served. Humata Health launched a standalone platform for independent practices/specialty clinics in June 2026 that analyzes documentation against payer policies and identifies gaps; EasyPA prepares packets and submits through FHIR; Roseate targets independent specialty practices; HiPaaS assembles clinical documentation and submits/tracks; Optum/Humata embeds the workflow in EHRs. CMS also has 29 early-adopter organizations working on electronic PA ahead of 2027. This materially reduces the competition gap.
next_step: Do not build generic evidence-pack automation. Reopen only if interviews reveal a specialty-specific or payer-specific second-order workflow incumbents systematically fail, with willingness to pay demonstrated before integration work.
